user.title: Connect to Irrigreen controller
user.description: Enter the controller's IP address on your network. On a segmented network the controller is usually on its own VLAN, so enter the address directly (for example 192.168.1.50).

error.cannot_connect: Could not reach an Irrigreen controller at that address. Check the IP and that Home Assistant can route to the controller's network.

abort.already_configured: This controller is already set up.
